osiris-rex.reason: Current is untextured white boxes at 34.7 m. VTAD model is textured with TAGSAM arm extended, sample capsule, HGA. Source was ~1.7x oversize (10.6 m); scaled x0.5863 so solar-array span = 6.2 m (NASA fact-sheet length); bus then ~2.0 m (real 2.43 m), so scale is approximate.
